name: agrosync
description: AgroSync – CitizenTech Rural: frete coletivo, crédito justo e alertas para pequenos produtores.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
